title: Solar COB Lamp – Portable with USB Charging
descriptionHtml:
Light when you need it – even without power

During a power outage or far out in nature, batteries easily run out. Then you're left completely without light when you need it most.

Charged by the sun or via USB

This lamp can be charged with both solar cells and USB. It gives bright COB light and can also charge your phone in an emergency.

Features

  • Charged via solar cells or USB
  • Bright COB light
  • Can charge your phone in an emergency
  • Foldable and easy to hang up
  • Great for camping, fishing and power outages

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
